args.title: Validate TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES environment variable format
args.body:
File: src/config.ts

Change int() parsing to reject invalid formats like "12h" and require a numeric value, so setting TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES to a valid minute count works correctly. This prevents minutes being misinterpreted as 12 when given as "12h".

label: bug
file: src/config.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The config.ts file parses TOKEN_TTL_MINUTES as an integer without validating the format, so "12h" was accepted but wrongly parsed as 12. This causes token expiration after 12 minutes instead of 720. The fix is to validate and reject non-integer formats for this variable.

args.title: Fix Accept-Language header handling to respect q weights
args.body:
File: src/i18n/index.ts

The pickLocale function currently picks the first supported language ignoring the q weights in the Accept-Language header. Update it to parse and respect q weights to choose the preferred language correctly, fixing the issue with French responses when French has higher q value.

label: bug
file: src/i18n/index.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The pickLocale function that chooses language from Accept-Language header ignores the q weights and simply picks the first supported language. This causes languages with higher q values later in the header to be ignored. The fix is to parse and use q weights correctly.
